case.title: A refused first message on a brand-new UUID creates the row with the right owner and saved messages
case.preconditions: BLOCKED BY SETUP (rule AF): Database access unconfirmed. — run once it exists. Precondition: S1, S2 and S4 passed.
steps: Generate a new UUID that has never been used. Send an off-topic (soft-rule) message as its first message.
Query user_id, soft_refusals, blocked_at, messages and debug_data for the UUID.
case.expected: The response is a judgeRejection (blocked:false). The row exists with user_id = test user A and soft_refusals=1, and messages/debug_data are filled in. The RPC created the row first, and upsertStreamedText then took the 23505 → update path with no error.
case.expected_outcome: The insert race between the refusal RPC and the message upsert is handled.
case.credentials: Supabase user access token (Bearer JWT) for test user A
case.environment: target test env — API base URL not in sources
case.how_to_verify: Checked from outside (HTTP response): Run the SQL query. In the API logs there should be no streamed_text_write_failed event for this UUID.
